subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Comparar informações sobre um mesmo fato veiculadas em diferentes mídias e concluir sobre qual é mais confiável e por quê.

components.description_pt: Comparar detalhes enfatizados em duas diferentes reportagens sobre o mesmo assunto
components.description_en: Compare the details emphasized across two different media accounts of the same subject
components.cc_component_description: Compare the details emphasized across two different media accounts of the same subject

components.description_pt: Identificar diferenças em fatos, ênfase ou enquadramento entre fontes de notícia
components.description_en: Identify differences in facts, emphasis, or framing across news sources
components.cc_component_description: Contrast how two texts on the same topic differ in the information or emphasis they provide

components.description_pt: Avaliar a confiabilidade de uma fonte de notícia com base em evidências textuais
components.description_en: Evaluate the reliability of a news source based on textual evidence
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the relevance and reliability of evidence supporting a stated claim

components.description_pt: Justificar qual fonte é mais confiável e explicar o raciocínio
components.description_en: Justify which source is more trustworthy and explain the reasoning
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate which source most effectively addresses a specific question or problem

cc_matches.description: Analyze various accounts of a subject told in different mediums (e.g., a person's life story in both print and multimedia), determining which details are emphasized in each account.
Compare and contrast the most important points and key details presented in two texts on the same topic.
Draw on information from multiple print or digital sources, demonstrating the ability to locate an answer to a question quickly or to solve a problem efficiently.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar argumentos para...
*determinar afirmaciones
* evaluar el razonamiento y evidencia clara, relevante y confiable de afirmaciones
* identificar lenguaje que crea un estilo formal
* comprender la lógica y estrategia de razones y evidencia
* reconocer el uso de textos multimodales y translingüísticos con atención a diversas
audiencias
* discernir las declaraciones hechas por el autor
